headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 18, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-6 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win. Junior Caminero led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBI. In other games, the Baltimore Orioles defeated the Washington Nationals 7-3 behind Gunnar Henderson's 4-hit, 1-home run performance, and the Philadelphia Phillies shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-0 behind Zack Wheeler's 7-inning outing with 8 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries. A.J. Minter has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to left lat surgery. Other injured players include Brendan Donovan (Seattle Mariners, left groin muscle strain), Jack Dreyer (Los Angeles Dodgers, left shoulder discomfort), Hunter Harvey (Chicago Cubs, right triceps inflammation), Ty Madden (Detroit Tigers, right forearm contusion), Ryan O'Hearn (Pittsburgh Pirates, right quad muscle strain), Jose Trevino (Cincinnati Reds, left hamstring injury), and Tommy Nance (Toronto Blue Jays, right forearm discomfort).

The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays in a trade for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams and traded right-handed pitcher Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Red Sox 8-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-1 behind a strong performance from Grant Holmes, who pitched 6.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Austin Riley led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Minter Lands on 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: New York Mets left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to left lat surgery.

top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash on May 17, 2026.
